competitors.name: Wealthsimple Gold
competitors.specialty: The most dangerous competitor in Canada — physically-backed gold trading inside an app millions already trust.

competitors.name: Gold ETFs (CGL / CGL.C)
competitors.specialty: The default for any financially literate Canadian — commission-free, TFSA/RRSP-eligible paper gold.

competitors.name: OneGold
competitors.specialty: The strongest US incumbent — an APMEX × Sprott JV, the most credible parentage in the category.

competitors.name: Vaulted
competitors.specialty: Simplest US vaulted-gold app — one all-in 1.8% fee, $10 minimum (the same entry point Auri markets).

competitors.name: US Gold ETFs (GLD, IAU)
competitors.specialty: The real US volume competitor — commission-free in every brokerage, IRA/401(k)-eligible.

competitors.name: APMEX / JM Bullion / Costco
competitors.specialty: Physical bullion to your door. Costco selling gold bars is the clearest signal US retail gold demand is real — these are lead sources, not competitors.

competitors.name: Glint Pay
competitors.specialty: The clearest precedent for spending gold — a Mastercard debit card spending gold in 210 countries.

competitors.name: Kinesis Money
competitors.specialty: The most feature-complete gold-money platform and the most direct philosophical rival — and it pays a yield on gold.

competitors.name: Goldmoney
competitors.specialty: Buy-and-park vaulted gold. 1.0% round trip. No spend, borrow, or yield.

competitors.name: BullionVault
competitors.specialty: Vaulted gold with a storage minimum (~$144/yr) and 2.5-10% redemption fees.

competitors.name: Ledn
competitors.specialty: The most important competitor to watch — Tether partnered with Ledn to let XAUT holders borrow against gold. Literally Auri's core product, from the token issuer.

competitors.name: Coinbase
competitors.specialty: Lends USDC against BTC from ~4% APR, built on Morpho, running on Base. The architectural distance to Auri is close to zero.

competitors.name: Nexo
competitors.specialty: Crypto-backed credit lines on 100+ assets, 1.9-18.9% APR. Relaunched in the US in 2026 (excl. New York).

competitors.name: Milo
competitors.specialty: Crypto mortgages from 10.75% fixed — $100M+ originated, including a record $12M single loan.

competitors.name: APX Lending
competitors.specialty: Canadian crypto-backed loans — the direct Ledn competitor in Canada.

competitors.name: Morpho / Aave (direct DeFi)
competitors.specialty: A sophisticated user can do exactly what Auri does, manually, for less — but ~99.9% of the target market never will.

competitors.name: Indian gold loans (Muthoot, Rupeek, IIFL)
competitors.specialty: The mature, mass-market gold-loan industry — 8-15% APR. Auri at 3.75% is 2-4x cheaper than the entire Indian industry.

competitors.name: Gnosis Pay
competitors.specialty: Fully self-custodial Visa spending stablecoins from a Safe smart account — the architectural pattern Auri uses, on crypto.

competitors.name: Ether.fi Cash
competitors.specialty: Self-custodial Visa where you spend, borrow, OR earn against ETH/BTC/stablecoins — collateral still earns yield while you spend, 76 countries.

competitors.name: Wise / Remitly / Western Union
competitors.specialty: Remittance incumbents. Auri doesn't beat them on price — it makes remittance a side effect of holding gold, and every gift-claim link a viral acquisition loop.

competitors.name: India digital gold (Jar, SafeGold, MMTC-PAMP)
competitors.specialty: 80M+ Indians already invest in digital gold — micro-savings into gold is validated at massive scale. Essential diaspora-GTM context.

taxonomy.description: Spend, send, and borrow against real gold - the utility angle.
Auri holds $0; gold in your own name, attested quarterly.
Dollars buy less each year; gold that finally moves.
Real grams by link, QR or @username - occasions built in.
Developer rails for building on allocated gold (unverified - see Tier C).
